_template: News or event, 5 scenes, about 45s, landscape. Every claim carries its date in the spoken line, never the word today: a news video outlives the day it was made.

style.artPrompt: editorial photo-illustration style, semi realistic, muted documentary palette, strong directional light, shallow depth of field, restrained and factual mood, no text, no lettering, no numbers, no logos, no watermark

scenes.narration: WHAT HAPPENED. The event and its date, stated flat. No adjectives, no speculation, no word today.

images.prompt: A wide shot of the place where the event happened, documentary framing, overcast light.
A closer detail of the same place that carries the consequence.

scenes.narration: THE NUMBER. The one figure that makes this matter, spelled as words, with the source named.

images.prompt: An image that represents the scale of the number without being a chart, physical and tangible.

scenes.narration: BACKGROUND. The minimum context needed to understand the event. One or two sentences only.

images.prompt: An archival feeling image of the earlier period, muted palette, softer light.

scenes.narration: WHO IS AFFECTED. Name the group and how it reaches them, concretely.

images.prompt: Ordinary people in the situation described, documentary framing, natural light.
A detail shot of the practical effect on their day.

scenes.narration: WHAT NEXT. The next milestone and its date. If the outcome is uncertain, say so plainly.

images.prompt: A forward looking image, a road, a doorway or a calendar-free horizon, dawn light.
